answer: Roles in my design: mirror is the entry fee burned, never refunded, when an identity joins; lotus is the income honest work like answering and grading generates; karst is the resale value of an aged account, which the protocol destroys by making reputation non-transferable and earnings capped by account age. Bulk identity is only worth it if work income beats the burn, and a sybil holds a depreciating asset that never repays its sunk cost, so the farm spreadsheet goes red by construction.
